objects.description: During the [Unitronics Defacement Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0031), the [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) discovered and exploited default credentials found on many Unitronics [Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0003) [Human-Machine Interface (HMI)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0002). For many of these devices, the default password was set to ‘1111’.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)(Citation: CISA Unitronics November 2023)
objects.description_fa: در طول [کمپین Unitronics Defacement](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0031)، [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) اعتبار پیش‌فرض موجود در بسیاری از Unitronics [Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)]_Pachine[MERC]_Pachine[MERC]_Pachine[4] را کشف کرد و از آنها سوء استفاده کرد. رابط (HMI)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0002). برای بسیاری از این دستگاه‌ها، رمز عبور پیش‌فرض روی «1111» تنظیم شده است.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)(Citation: CISA Unitronics November 2023) https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0003
